title: People’s Mañanera November 16
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**“The Poor Come First” Policy Delivers Results: Mexico Leads Poverty
Reduction in Latin America  
** The World Bank estimates that 17.3 million people will have been lifted out
of income poverty in Mexico between 2018 and 2026. The UN’s Economic
Commission on Latin America and the Caribbean (ECLAC) notes that Mexico
accounted for 60% of the reduction in poverty in Latin America and the
Caribbean in 2024.

**Sheinbaum Brings the Voice of a Sovereign Mexico to APEC  
** In Shenzhen, China, in the context of her visit to participate in the Asia
Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, President Claudia Sheinbaum met
with the Mexican community, will address business leaders, and will hold
bilateral meetings with Xi Jinping and Mark Carney to promote development
cooperation.

**Interior Ministry Supports the Proposal to Clarify What Occurred in the 2006
Election  
** Interior Minister Rosa Icela Rodríguez welcomed the Chamber of Deputies’
initiative to establish a commission to clarify the events surrounding the
2006 electoral fraud. In response to references to the 1988 elections, she
maintained that clarifying these episodes is key for Mexican history and
democracy.

**Claudia Sheinbaum Has the Highest Approval Ratings in Latin America  
** The President tops the CB Global Data ranking. The Ministry of the Interior
(SEGOB) linked this popular support to the results of the Transformation:
higher wages, greater purchasing power, and well-being programs that directly
benefit families.
